newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends lower on Tokyo's losses.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends lower on Tokyo's losses.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended lower in continued slow trading after a weaker close in Tokyo had further discouraged buyers' interest, dealers said.
"The market was down because of Tokyo's falls," a dealer said. "Buyers were cautious following the fall in overseas prices," he said.
Some scattered enquiries were seen from Far-East and selected European buyers for SMR grades and latex rubber," the dealer said, adding that buyers were just checking on the price levels.
December RSS Ones buyer ended 1.50 cents at 319 cents ($1.26) a kg and December SMR 20 buyer was down 2.50 cents to 305.50.
Traders offered the SMR CV at 363, SMR L at 343, SMR 5 at 318, SMR 10 at 307, SMR 20 at 306 and drum latex at 235.
The INRO five-day moving average rose to 243.51 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Nov 28 from 243.86 on Nov 27. The daily indicator price dipped to 242.92 from 243.15.
